zarr backend of the store layer (reading)

Source: R/io-store-zarr.R
io-store-zarr.Rd

The read operations of io-store for a local zarr directory store, version 2 or 3, sharded or not, consolidated or not, through Rarr. The write operations are in io-store-zarr-write.

Usage

zarr_open(path, call = rlang::caller_env())

Arguments

path

Path of the store directory.

call

The call reported by errors.

Details

A handle is a zarr_node: the store directory, the absolute path of the node within the store and the zarr format. Metadata is always read from the node's own files, so consolidated metadata is neither needed nor trusted. Rarr cannot read complex values, and turns 64-bit integers (and uint32) beyond the R integer range into NA. Those arrays are read again as 32-bit integers or float64 from a temporary copy of the array with a trailing dimension, which holds the same bytes, and the values are put together in R.
